description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrValidator' which is responsible for validating and transforming HTML attributes within tokens as part of the HTMLPurifier library. It manages attribute validation, transformation, and sanitization for HTML elements.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrValidator
classes.description: A class responsible for validating and transforming HTML element attributes within tokens, ensuring they conform to safety and style rules.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Validates the attributes of a given token, performing transformations and removing invalid attributes to ensure safe HTML output.
